offering_description.value: EverCommerce sells cloud software to home service contractors, healthcare practices, and beauty and wellness businesses. Its tools help customers schedule work, manage jobs or appointments, bill clients, and accept payments. It also provides marketing and medical billing services.

primary_products.value: field service management software; practice management and electronic health record software; salon and spa management software; invoicing and payments software; customer engagement software

primary_services.value: payment processing; digital marketing and lead generation; medical billing and revenue cycle management

customer_segment.value: B2B: Home service contractors, independent healthcare practices, salons, spas, and other small and midsize service businesses

end_markets.value: home improvement and repair; outpatient healthcare; beauty and personal wellness

revenue_model.value: subscription: Access to cloud software for field service, healthcare practices, salons, and spas; transaction or usage fees: Processing card and electronic payments through its software; service fees: Digital marketing, lead generation, and outsourced medical billing
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops cloud applications using industry workflows and payment integrations for contractors, healthcare practices, salons, and spas; service provider: Uses customer marketing and billing data to generate leads and manage claims for service businesses and healthcare practices

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with customers in Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand

specialization.value: related lines: Home service, healthcare practice, and salon and spa software with shared payments and customer engagement functions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams selling industry-specific software and services to business owners and practice managers; online: Product websites and mobile app stores for self-service signups

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: HIPAA rules for handling patient data and payment security standards for processing card transactions

notes: The current scope of the marketing services and beauty and wellness lines is uncertain.
